contributions: DreamDojo uses large-scale egocentric human video and continuous latent actions to pretrain a robot world model, then reports bounded policy-evaluation and planning benefits after robot post-training.

method.summary: Pretrain on 44k hours of egocentric video with continuous latent proxy actions, post-train on target robot data, and distill for real-time inference.
assumptions: Author order records collaboration but is not used to infer individual contribution.

study_context.sample_or_scale: Human-video pretraining plus task-specific robot post-training; downstream validation concentrates on AgiBot fruit packing.

evaluation.design: OOD video benchmarks, action control, fruit-packing policy evaluation, model-based planning, and live teleoperation demonstrations.
